title: TRICARE Prime First Installment: Choice of the Payment Refunded
content:
**Rule.** For the first installment of a new fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment: where more than one payment stands against the first installment and the latest of them was made through a method other than the enrollment's payment arrangement, the duplicate refund returns that latest payment; where more than one stands and the latest was collected through the arrangement's own method, it returns the earlier payments together; otherwise it returns the smaller of the latest payment and the earlier payments together.

## Positive and negative cases (hypothetical, arrangement: recurring card)

| Payments against the first installment, in posting order | Returned |
|---|---|
| 65.02 by recurring card, then 65.02 by check | the 65.02 check payment (latest, other method) |
| 65.02 by check, then 65.02 by recurring card | the earlier payments together, 65.02 (latest through the arrangement's own method) |
| 65.02 by check, 30.00 by check, then 65.02 by recurring card | the earlier payments together, 95.02 |
| 65.02 by recurring card only | the smaller of 65.02 and 0.00, that is 0.00 |
